Filmmaker Alleges Humiliation, Akshay Kumar's Production House Issues Warning Over 'Hera Pheri 3'

Filmmaker Priyadarshan has claimed he was humiliated and prevented from making 'Hera Pheri 3' with Akshay Kumar. Following Priyadarshan's exit from the project, Akshay Kumar's production house has issued a warning, asserting legal rights over the film.
